final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec `low_area_control` was taken down the full fidelity ladder: L1 spent all 400 evaluations in the structured DSE graph (refine → refine → stop), producing a 38-design feasible Pareto front dominated by compact iterative CORDIC designs; the selection rule (min luts_plus_ffs) picked `iterative:data_width=15, n_iter=12, angle_guard=1, rounding=round` (est. 251 LUT+FF, 10.1 accuracy bits, 13.2 MSPS, max error 2^-10.09). L2 confirmed the DDS system context (SFDR 79.8 dBc, SNR 69.5 dB, 15-cycle latency) with no selection change. L3 RTL verification passed exhaustively (32768/32768 angles, 0 mismatches) on both Verilator and Icarus; L4 recorded synthesis measured 216 LUTs / 107 FFs at 150.7 MHz; L5 back-annotation showed the cost model under-predicts area (~19% LUTs, ~11% FFs) but flagged no winner change, so no reexplore was needed. The spec was finalized with the iterative design, and a calibration lesson was stored for future campaigns.
